verdicts.explanation: The Table in Fig. 5 gives 7.51 (σ) for Li7P3S11 with MTP_PBE,optB88, and the text says σ300K is 7.51 mS cm−1 from MD at 300K, so the value, unit, material and computational origin are correct.
The Fig. 5 table gives 6.50 (σ*) for Li7P3S11 at 300K from this paper's MTP_PBE,optB88 MD, so the value and computational origin are right; leaving the kind as unspecified is acceptable.
The introduction attributes the 57 mS cm−1 room-temperature AIMD prediction for Li7P3S11 to Chu et al. [13], so literature_cited is correct and the value and unit match.

The paper cites 17 mS cm−1 as the highest experimental room-temperature conductivity of Li7P3S11 from ref. [10], which matches the record's literature_cited origin and value; the EIS label is a minor method gloss rather than a stated fact.
The value 14 mS cm−1 for Li3YCl6 from Wang et al. [29] is reported in the paper's σ300K row, so the temperature is 300 K rather than null, and the record's temperature is wrong.
The 0.51 mS cm−1 value for Li3YCl6 from Asano et al. [21] is listed under the σ300K heading and the intro calls it a room-temperature conductivity, so a null temperature is not correct.
